This fixture shows the APPROVED invocation pattern — the bridge key is read from the
environment, never hard-coded. The scanner must PASS (produce zero findings) on it.

const key = process.env.CLAUDE_BRIDGE_KEY;
if (!key) { throw new Error('CLAUDE_BRIDGE_KEY is not configured'); }
const headers = { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.CLAUDE_BRIDGE_KEY}` };
# PowerShell (placeholder, no value): $env:CLAUDE_BRIDGE_KEY="<secure value entered by the user>"
